name: theme
title: Theme
description: Corsair colour, radius and base styles for light and dark mode. Every component relies on these variables; override --primary, --primary-foreground and --ring to apply your brand.

name: theme-blue
title: Theme: Blue
description: The Corsair theme on a slate base with a blue primary. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

name: theme-violet
title: Theme: Violet
description: The Corsair theme on a zinc base with a violet primary. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

name: theme-rose
title: Theme: Rose
description: The Corsair theme on a stone base with a rose primary. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

name: theme-emerald
title: Theme: Emerald
description: The Corsair theme on a zinc base with an emerald primary. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

name: theme-amber
title: Theme: Amber
description: The Corsair theme on a stone base with an amber primary and square corners. Installs the theme first, then sets its colours and radius; every text pair meets WCAG AA.

name: button
title: Button
description: Triggers an action. Variants default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link; sizes sm, default, lg and three square icon sizes. Supports asChild and a loading state.

name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: Animated status indicator for work in progress, announced as Loading.

name: badge
title: Badge
description: Short status or metadata label. Solid, secondary and outline styles, plus success, warning and destructive statuses shown as a coloured dot.

name: label
title: Label
description: Accessible name for a form control.

name: input
title: Input
description: Single-line text control. Its error state comes from aria-invalid, so any form library can drive it.

name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Multi-line text control with the same states as Input.

name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: An input with icons, text or buttons attached on either side.

name: field
title: Field
description: Layout for a control with its label, description and error, plus fieldset and group helpers. Independent of any form library.

name: form
title: Form Field (react-hook-form)
description: FormField: a react-hook-form Controller laid out with Field, with the id, label and ARIA wiring done for you.

name: checkbox
title: Checkbox
description: Checkbox with checked, unchecked and indeterminate states.

name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: A set of options where exactly one can be selected.

name: switch
title: Switch
description: On/off control for settings that apply immediately.

name: select
title: Select
description: Pick one option from a list, with groups, labels and separators.

name: separator
title: Separator
description: Horizontal or vertical divider.

name: card
title: Card
description: Container with header, title, description, action, content and footer parts.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: Callout for important messages on a neutral surface; default, success, warning and destructive tones colour the icon.

name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Placeholder shape shown while content loads.

name: popover
title: Popover
description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, with header, title and description parts.

name: command
title: Command
description: Searchable list navigated with the arrow keys; the base for comboboxes and command menus.

name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Month grid for picking a date, several dates or a range, with dropdown captions and week numbers. Built on DayPicker.

name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: DatePicker and DateRangePicker: a calendar in a popover behind a button that shows the chosen date or range.

name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A select with a search box, for long lists of options.

name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: One-time code input drawn as separate slots, with paste and autofill support.

name: slider
title: Slider
description: Pick a number or a range by dragging or with the arrow keys, horizontal or vertical.

name: toggle
title: Toggle
description: A button that stays pressed, in default and outline variants and three sizes.

name: toggle-group
title: Toggle Group
description: A set of toggles with single or multiple selection, joined or spaced apart.

name: number-input
title: Number Input
description: Number field with decrement and increment buttons, min, max and step, following the spinbutton keyboard pattern.

name: password-input
title: Password Input
description: Password field with a button that shows what was typed.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short label shown on hover and keyboard focus.

name: reveal
title: Reveal
description: Fades and moves content into place when it scrolls into view, alone or staggered in a group. Visible without JavaScript.

name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: Reveals text word by word, when it comes into view or tied to the scroll position.

name: magnetic
title: Magnetic
description: Pulls its content toward the mouse while hovered and springs it back on leave.

name: parallax
title: Parallax
description: Drifts content at a different speed from the page as it scrolls past, with CSS scroll-driven animations and no JavaScript.

name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
description: A soft light that follows the pointer across a surface and along its edge.

name: animated-border
title: Animated Border
description: A border with a light travelling around it, paused off screen.

name: aurora
title: Aurora
description: Slow, soft light drifting behind its content, from three radial gradients.

name: signature
title: Signature
description: Draws SVG strokes as if by hand, with optional ink filling in behind the pen, on view or with the scroll.

name: copy-button
title: Copy Button
description: An icon button that copies a value and swaps to a check mark, announcing it to screen readers.

name: dash-button
title: Dash Button
description: A pill button whose fill gives way to a dashed outline that marches on hover.

name: color-swatches
title: Color Swatches
description: Pick one colour from a row of swatches: a radio group with arrow keys and form support.

name: bars-spinner
title: Bars Spinner
description: Twelve bars around a hub fading in turn, announced as Loading. No JavaScript.

name: shimmer-text
title: Shimmer Text
description: A band of light sweeping across text now and then, paused off screen.

name: blur-text
title: Blur Text
description: Text that comes into focus one character at a time, and can blur back out.

name: slide-text
title: Slide Text
description: Words, characters or lines rising into place from below their own baseline.

name: flip-text
title: Flip Text
description: Kinetic type in 3D: characters or words turning into place around their horizontal axis, one after another.

name: dissolve-text
title: Dissolve Text
description: Words or characters surfacing at scattered moments, the same on server and client.

name: highlight-text
title: Highlight Text
description: A marker that slides in behind a phrase, or a hand-drawn line drawn under it.

name: scramble-text
title: Scramble Text
description: Text that decodes itself: noise sweeps across, then each character locks in.

name: wave-text
title: Wave Text
description: Bands of colour washing through text like a swell, on one CSS animation.

name: text-signature
title: Text Signature
description: Writes any text in any font as a signature: outlines drawn by the pen, then inked.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Content scrolling in a seamless loop, pausing on focus and off screen, and draggable by the pointer.

name: line-chart
title: Line Chart
description: One series as a line, with a cursor that snaps to points; a slider for keyboards and screen readers.

name: qr-code
title: QR Code
description: A crisp SVG QR code in dots, rounded or square modules. Renders on the server.

name: tweet-card
title: Tweet Card
description: A post from X in your theme, with no embed script: a card, a server component that fetches by id, and a client one.

name: spotify-card
title: Spotify Card
description: A track card with cover art, a link to Spotify and a preview clip that spins a record while it plays.

name: light-rays
title: Light Rays
description: Soft beams of light falling from above, from a small WebGL2 shader.

name: warp-gradient
title: Warp Gradient
description: A liquid field of colour carried along by layered noise, from one WebGL2 shader.

name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Modal window centred over the page, with a focus trap, overlay, close button, header, footer, title and description parts.

name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: Modal that asks the user to confirm or cancel before an action, with action and cancel buttons.

name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: Dialog that slides in from any edge of the screen, for menus, filters and side panels.

name: toast
title: Toast
description: Brief notifications shown with a toast() call and a Toaster mounted once, with variants, an optional action, swipe to dismiss and screen reader announcements.

name: nav-link
title: Nav Link
description: A navigation link that marks the current page with aria-current and data-active. Supports asChild for router links.

name: site-header
title: Site Header
description: A sticky page header with brand, navigation, actions and a sheet menu for small screens, flagging data-scrolled once the page scrolls.

name: dock
title: Dock
description: A floating bar of icon links pinned to the bottom or top of the viewport, with tooltips and an optional reveal after scrolling.

name: tabs
title: Tabs
description: Sections of content shown one at a time, with a segmented or underlined tab list, horizontal or vertical.

name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A round picture of a person with a fallback while it loads or when it fails, in three sizes, plus an overlapping group.

name: rating
title: Rating
description: Stars for giving a score as a radio group, or for showing one read-only with fractional fills.

name: stat
title: Stat
description: Key figures as a description list: label, value and a caption with an optional trend arrow.

name: number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
description: A number that counts up to its value when it comes into view, formatted for the locale.

name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: A block of code with an optional caption, a language label and a copy button.

name: corner-frame
title: Corner Frame
description: A box with bracket marks on its corners, in any size, thickness, colour and inset.

name: youtube-embed
title: YouTube Embed
description: A YouTube video that costs one poster image until it is played, with player controls through its ref.

name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: Slides on a native scroll-snap track, with keyboard steps, previous and next buttons, dots and an optional coverflow look.

name: preloader
title: Preloader
description: A full-screen cover that counts to 100 on first load, waits for your content to be ready, then fades out.

name: custom-cursor
title: Custom Cursor
description: A dot and a trailing ring that follow a mouse pointer, growing over interactive elements and showing labels.

name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll Progress
description: A reading progress bar that fills as the page scrolls, with CSS scroll-driven animations and no JavaScript.

name: scroll-background
title: Scroll Background
description: A background that blends from one colour to the next as you scroll, with CSS scroll-driven animations and no JavaScript.

name: smooth-scroll
title: Smooth Scroll
description: Smooth wheel and trackpad scrolling for the page, off with reduced motion, with a scrollTo hook that works either way.

name: grain
title: Grain
description: Film grain over a surface, from a tile of SVG noise, with an optional stepped jitter.

name: hover-reveal
title: Hover Reveal
description: A second layer seen through a soft circle that follows the pointer.

name: particles
title: Particles
description: Dots drifting slowly across a surface, laid out from a seed and moved with CSS alone.

name: topography
title: Topography
description: Contour lines like a topographic map over slowly shifting terrain, from one WebGL2 shader.

name: roll-text
title: Roll Text
description: Characters that roll up to a copy of themselves on hover or keyboard focus.

name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: A menu of actions and options that opens from a button, with checkbox and radio items, labels, shortcuts and submenus.

name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: A menu of actions for an area of the page that opens on right click or long press, with checkbox and radio items, labels, shortcuts and submenus.

name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: Site navigation with links and triggers that open panels of links in a shared, animated viewport.

name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: A preview card that appears while a link is hovered or focused, for supplementary content.

name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: Stacked sections that open and close under their headings, one or several at a time, with a height animation.

name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: A region that a trigger button shows and hides, with a height animation.

name: progress
title: Progress
description: A progress bar for tasks with a known amount, or an indeterminate one when the amount is unknown.

name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: A scrolling box with thin themed scrollbars that keeps native scrolling.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: The trail of links from the top of a site to the current page, with separators and an ellipsis.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page links with previous and next, an ellipsis, and a helper that works out which page numbers to show.

name: table
title: Table
description: A data table on native table elements, with a scroll container, selected rows and sortable column headers.

name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: An application sidebar that collapses to icons or off canvas on desktop and opens as a sheet on mobile, with a keyboard shortcut.

name: drawer
title: Drawer
description: A bottom sheet dialog for phones that can also be dragged down to close.

name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: A table with sortable headers, a text filter, pagination and row selection, built on TanStack Table v9.

name: dropzone
title: Dropzone
description: A file drop area on a native file input that checks type, size and count, and lists the chosen files.

name: kbd
title: Kbd
description: A key or key combination shown as a small keycap, alone or in a group.

name: empty-state
title: Empty State
description: What a list, table or page shows when it has nothing in it yet, with an icon, title, description and actions.

name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: The steps of a multi-step flow with complete, current and upcoming states, horizontal or vertical.

name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: A vertical list of events with a coloured dot for each status and a line joining them.

name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Panels resized by dragging or with the keyboard, side by side or stacked.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: One series as vertical or horizontal bars that grow in on first view, with a keyboard slider over the bars.

name: area-chart
title: Area Chart
description: One or more series as gradient-filled areas, stacked or overlapping, with a legend and a keyboard slider over the points.

name: donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: Parts of a whole as a ring with the total in the middle and a keyboard-navigable legend of values and shares.

name: hero
title: Hero
description: The opening section of a landing page with an eyebrow, a title, a description, actions and an optional media slot.

name: feature-grid
title: Feature Grid
description: A grid of features with an icon, a title and a description under a centred section header.

name: stats
title: Stats
description: A row of key figures that count up when they scroll into view, under a centred section header.

name: logo-cloud
title: Logo Cloud
description: Customer or partner logos in a grid or a scrolling marquee under a small title.

name: cta
title: Call to Action
description: A closing band with a title, a description and one or two actions.

name: pricing
title: Pricing
description: A pricing section with plan cards, a featured plan and an optional monthly or yearly billing switch.

name: faq
title: FAQ
description: A frequently asked questions section with a header and the answers in an accordion, split or stacked.

name: testimonials
title: Testimonials
description: A section of customer quotes with names, roles and avatars, in a masonry or grid layout.

name: contact-form
title: Contact Form
description: A contact section with a header, contact details and a validated message form that reports pending, success and error states.

name: newsletter
title: Newsletter
description: A compact sign-up band with an inline email form that reports pending, success and error states.

name: site-footer
title: Site Footer
description: A page footer with a brand, link columns in a navigation landmark, a copyright line and optional social icon links.

name: login-form
title: Login Form
description: A centred sign-in card with email and password fields, a remember-me checkbox, optional sign-in providers and pending, success and error states.

name: signup-form
title: Signup Form
description: A centred sign-up card with name, email and password fields, a required terms checkbox, optional sign-up providers and pending, success and error states.

name: not-found
title: Not Found
description: A 404 page section with a large decorative error code, a page heading, a description, an optional search slot and actions.

name: dashboard
title: Dashboard
description: An application page with a collapsible sidebar, a header, stat cards, a line chart and a recent-activity table.

name: settings
title: Settings
description: An account settings page with tabs for a profile form, a password change and delete-account dialog, and notification switches.
